properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-10-24, choosing the recommendation: "composition: each" on the existing Constraint (each stated part judged alone; the verdict reads the worst part and names it; an empty or unstated set reads incomplete).

THE QUESTION. reflow2's only numeric limit was a budget its parts spend together (`composition` sum or path). A setback, a clearance or a separation distance is a limit EACH part meets on its own, and its parts do not add. Measured on main 61c05ad74 (the Shop sample trial, design 671a764fa790c030): two parts 6 ft from a line against a 10 ft minimum read within (12); the barn lean-to's 12 ft from the well, recorded against the 100 ft limit, rolled up with the farm loop's 102.36 ft to 114.36 and read within.

OPTIONS WEIGHED, ranked by correctness: (a) `composition: each` on the existing Constraint, reusing CONSTRAINS edges and every reader of the judged rollup [CHOSEN]; (b) a bound per pair of named nodes (the well as a node), more exact when both ends move, more vocabulary; (c) codes as EnvironmentRule + VIOLATES_RULE, which matches the schema's wording for codes but judges no number; (d) one Constraint per part, which works today and multiplies 23 limits by every part, the workaround shape refused.

WHAT IT MEANS. The verdict reads the smallest stated reading against a minimum and the largest against a maximum, named in `judged_part`. A stated part already short of a minimum breaks it whatever the unstated parts read; otherwise an unstated part, or no stated part at all, reads incomplete. Declared by the author, never inferred from the unit (the 2026-09-29 rule of dec:idea-a-constraint-says-how-its-quantity-composes stands).
